resources.string: Fastrack Watch & Health Connect Sync Bridge

Athlete 360 Companion accesses your health records (Heart Rate, SpO2, Steps, Calories, and Sleep Duration) stored in Health Connect solely to synchronize them with your authenticated Athlete 360 account.\n\nAll health readings are transmitted securely over encrypted network connections directly to your designated Athlete 360 server. Your health data is never shared with third parties or advertisers, and permissions can be revoked at any time through Android Health Connect settings.
